description: Codex: Adeptus Custodes (11e) Shadowkeepers — WARDENS OF THE DARK CELLS (WP-C46): each time a melee attack targets a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit (not MONSTER / VEHICLE) within range of an objective marker, if the Strength of that attack is greater than the target's Toughness, subtract 1 from the wound roll. Fixture ork11e_o34_active (P1 Orks active, P2 Custodes); setup: P2 detachment Shadowkeepers, CP 0 for both, auto wound allocation, the Meganobz moved into base contact below Custodian Guard Alpha (T7, standing on the centre objective). Fight phase: both Pile In halves passed, a real click selects the Meganobz, all attacks at Custodian Guard Alpha, resolved: the Power Klaw's wound block (S > T7) carries -1 named 'Wardens of the Dark Cells (Shadowkeepers)' in the modifier ledger and the Dice Log.
